welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.tagline: Get ready to chat and <accent>specialize</accent> your <accent>own</accent> AI models!

notice.title: Important Notice
notice.local: Erudi runs entirely on your device — no data leaves your machine. Performance depends on your hardware.
notice.earlyRelease: This is an early release and some rough edges may remain. If you encounter an issue, we'd love to hear about it.
notice.feedback: Your feedback shapes what we build next — thank you for using Erudi.
notice.closing: Welcome to your private AI workspace

excellent.title: Excellent Hardware! 🚀
excellent.description: Your system has plenty of headroom. Even the largest models in your range will feel responsive.

good.title: Good Performance 👍
good.description: Your hardware runs your recommended range smoothly, and smaller models will feel instant.

fair.title: Fair Performance
fair.description: Smaller models will run well. The larger end of your range will work too, but expect some delays.

limited.title: Optimized for Smaller Models 💡
limited.description: Start with the smaller models tuned for limited hardware; they still give real results. Larger ones will run, but performance may vary.

recommendation.window: Your machine handles models from {{min}}B to {{max}}B comfortably.
